observations: Photo 0 shows a beige/cream manual sewing machine on a stand.
Brand/model text on the machine body reads “IDEAL TOPSTAR”.
A power cord is visible, and there is a foot pedal/control unit on the floor in front of the machine.
Machine surface looks used with visible dust/marks; no clear proof of accessories completeness from this single photo.

claims.claim: Ideal Topstar manual sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows “IDEAL TOPSTAR” on the machine.
Photo 0 does not clearly show a “Made in Japan” marking.
No video/test run is provided in the photos.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual.
claims.evidence: Only the machine and a pedal/control are visible; no laid-out accessory/manual photos.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service history or internal/serial evidence shown.

risks.risk: Whether it actually stitches correctly (timing, needle/bobbin tension, feed) even if the motor/hand motion seems fine.
risks.proof: A short video of a full test: threading + stitching a straight line on fabric, showing even stitches and no skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case for function).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (needles, bobbins, presser feet, spool pin, tools) and/or missing original manual.
risks.proof: Clear photos laid out of every accessory + the manual cover/first page.

risks.risk: Country-of-origin claim (Japanese made) may be incorrect.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating/serial plate showing “Made in …” and model/serial details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without assuming Japanese origin premium.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in one wide shot (rust inside, worn feed dogs, cracked plastic, bent needle bar).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle area, bobbin case area, feed dogs, and underside/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear.

proof_requests: Video test: thread the machine and stitch on fabric (straight + a turn) showing consistent stitches.
Photos of all accessories laid out (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, spool pin, tools) and the manual pages.
Close-up of the machine’s rating/serial plate showing “Made in …” and serial/model details.
Close-ups of needle/bobbin area and feed dogs (and underside/hinges) to confirm no hidden wear.
response.reason: The photos confirm the brand “IDEAL TOPSTAR” and show a used manual sewing machine with pedal, but they do not prove it stitches well, nor that accessories/manual are complete. Without a test and accessory checklist, a reliable worst-case price pick isn’t safe.
